''See also: [[Ryzer Raithe Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Ryzer Raithe is a prominent member of the [[Raithe family]] and serves as its primary diplomat. Residing in a luxurious villa on the planet [[Visiria]], he is characterized by his white hair, a pale gold third eye, and a physical build that is shorter and less muscular than his brother, Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion. Unlike Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion, who is a warrior, Ryzer is more scholarly and social, often engaging others through storytelling and an easy smile. Despite his diplomatic role, he has struggled with nervousness in certain social situations and carries the heavy emotional burden of having exiled his own brother. While he attempts to act out of altruism and guide Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's actions, his family has also been viewed as a source of political leverage by authorities.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Ryzer Raithe serves as the diplomat for the [[Raithe family]] and is the brother of Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion. Residing in a luxurious villa on the edge of a sea on the planet [[Visiria]], he is characterized by his pale gold third eye and thinning white hair. During discussions regarding the possibility of war with [[Visiria]], Ryzer assisted Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion in securing an audience with [[Senator Cyclon]]. When accompanying Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion on various journeys, Ryzer proves to be in his element during formal meetings.}}
